name: supplementary_macros

config.reason: F8 sweep item B6: replace typed literals with manifested macros; derivations only, no new compute

CicidsHeldoutAttackFreeRows.desc: synthetic held-out rows from days contributing zero attacks (Mon-Thu)

CicidsFridayHeldoutDensityPct.desc: attack density of the synthetic arm's Friday held-out sub-slice

SFourCicidsNaturalHstLiftAbs.desc: magnitude of HST's below-chance lift, natural arm

SFourCicidsPrevShiftAbsPp.desc: magnitude of the held-out prevalence shift

SSixDiagWindowRows.desc: records covered by the Stage-6 score-distribution diagnostic

CicidsEcodScoringBatch.desc: records in the single decision_function call that produced every CICIDS arm's ECOD scores (validation+test, scored together)

LitnetCaptureEcodScoringBatch.desc: records per decision_function call for each per-capture LITNET ECOD score

LitnetPooledEcodScoringBatch.desc: records in the decision_function call that produced the pooled LITNET ECOD score

SweepEcodScoringBatchMin.desc: smallest ECOD scoring batch across the prevalence sweep levels

SweepEcodScoringBatchMax.desc: largest ECOD scoring batch across the prevalence sweep levels

SSixOriginalLift.desc: Stage 6 original additive lift above the chance floor

SSixCorrectedLift.desc: Stage 6 corrected additive lift above the chance floor

LitnetPooledValBoundary.desc: row index where the pooled LITNET stream's held-out slice begins

LitnetCaptureHeldoutRows.desc: held-out rows per LITNET capture; three of these tile the pooled held-out slice exactly

LitnetCaptureValBoundary.desc: row index where each LITNET capture's held-out slice begins; three of these sum to the pooled boundary

RevEcodBatchLadder1.desc: intermediate scoring batch 1 of the ECOD batch-size ladder

RevEcodBatchLadder2.desc: intermediate scoring batch 2 of the ECOD batch-size ladder

SweepUnresampledLofMinusDetector.desc: LOF minus proposed-detector AUC-PR at the unresampled sweep level (both deterministic there)

notes: each value re-derived from the archived manifest named in inputs

extra.window_source: saturation_diagnostic() default in scripts/run_bocpd_ablation.py at the commit pinned by s6_bocpd_corrected_ablation_20260824T092655_a47acf51; the ablation manifest did not record it (noted, not hidden)
extra.ecod_batch_paths: every ECOD number in the paper is produced by a call of the form run_batch_reference('ecod', Xfit, np.vstack([Xva, Xte])) except the review analyses, which state their own batch
